description: AgentPay exposes pay-per-call AI microservices over a remote MCP server, with x402 USDC payment challenges for paid tool calls and a local stdio wallet-settlement option.

notes: No API key; tool calls use x402 USDC micropayments on Base.

clients: Any MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP, including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, and VS Code.

notes: GitHub repository and hosted endpoint were reachable during review.
